description: F7 rule 9 golden: B5 queue-aware cancels (iap.execution.fading.queue_cancel_rule; API_TRADING.md section 2.16) with the hazard probability leg (iap.execution.fill_hazard.FillHazardModel.features / bucket_hazards / p_fill_within on the UTC clock; `model` = the fitted document the port loads) and the X-4 depletion split read (iap.tca.markout.queue_bucket, ExecCalibration.queue_{exec_,cancel_,}depletion_hazard over `calibration_docs`, null = no document / no cell / no rate), plus iap.execution.sor_v2.hazard_fill_prob (lam null = None) and time_of_day on the UTC clock.
parity: canonical JSON bytes of `expected` (sorted keys, no whitespace, Python float repr) must equal the C++ port's canonical bytes; `expected_tol` (when present) is compared to `tolerance`

slice.rule: per sample and side, a child resting at the touch: ahead_qty = own L1 size; spread_ticks = ask - bid; imbalance = 1 - book_pressure(own, opp); depletion_per_s = queue_exec_depletion_hazard(side, ahead_qty) of calibration_docs['101'] (X-4); features = model.features(...); p_fill = p_fill_within(features, horizon_ns); rule = queue_cancel_rule(ahead_qty, max_ahead_qty, p_fill, min_p_fill)
